cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says authentication is used across services or channels.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 23 October 2026 that a method counts only where the state accepts it: AngolaID is a private company's service the state is not shown to accept, so it sets no rung (AGO-003). The Interior Ministry, prisons and migration service check the ID database for passport issuance (AGO-004); the national platform is at tender (AGO-001).
